bug_description.normalized: The staged PoC is a 192-byte raw regex byte string that `php-fuzz-mbstring` passes unchanged as the pattern argument to `mb_ereg()`/`mb_eregi()`. On the witnessed compile path, Oniguruma parses named capture groups from that pattern, stores each `BAG_MEMORY` node in `SCANENV_MEMENV(env)[regnum].mem_node`, and later sees a backreference that marks one of those capture nodes `BACKREF` during `check_backrefs()`. A `tune_look_behind()` invocation then computes a sure zero-length result for a look-behind body and applies the empty-look-behind optimization at `regcomp.c:4500-4504`, calling `onig_node_reset_empty(node)` without checking whether the body contains a capture group that is still back-referenced. `node_reset_str()`/`node_free_body()` therefore free the 72-byte capture node allocated from `parse_bag()`, but `SCANENV_MEMENV(env)[regnum].mem_node` still holds the dangling pointer. Later on the same compile path, another `node_char_len1()` backreference case follows `mem_env[backs[0]].mem_node` at `regcomp.c:906`, recurses into the freed node, and the switch on `NODE_TYPE(node)` at `regcomp.c:715` reads the freed heap object, matching the saved ASan heap-use-after-free READ 4. The staged patch bundle is unrelated; the direct source-side fix in upstream oniguruma is commit `42902c3e4dca3d0817861caa082f4c49b6c0f452`, which adds `used` tracking in `check_node_in_look_behind()` and changes the optimization guard to `ci.min == 0 && ci.min_is_sure != 0 && used == FALSE`.

source.description: Source. While parsing the attacker-controlled regex pattern, `parse_bag()` materializes a named capture group as a new `BAG_MEMORY` node and assigns it a capture-group number.
source.value_from: The staged `poc` is the exact 192-byte regex byte string fed to `php_mbregex_compile_pattern()` and `onig_new()`. Its bytes begin `(?<=` and include multiple named captures `(?<E>.)` plus `\k<E>` backreferences, so the parser reaches the named-group path in `parse_bag()` and allocates the capture node that later becomes freed and re-read.
source.note: This is the first vulnerability-relevant object materialization: the heap `Node` representing a witness-controlled capture group that later remains aliased in `SCANENV_MEMENV`.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

root_cause.description: Root cause. The empty-look-behind optimization frees the look-behind body whenever `ci.min == 0 && ci.min_is_sure != 0`, but the vulnerable source does not also require that the body contain no back-referenced capture groups.
root_cause.note: By this point `check_backrefs()` has already marked the relevant capture node `BACKREF`, yet the current source still takes the reset path and frees the body. The direct upstream repair in `42902c3e4dca3d0817861caa082f4c49b6c0f452` changes `check_node_in_look_behind()` to track whether a capture is used and updates this guard to `ci.min == 0 && ci.min_is_sure != 0 && used == FALSE`.

sink.description: ASan crash site. `node_char_len1()` switches on the `node_type` field of the freed capture node after a later backreference lookup reloads the dangling pointer from `SCANENV_MEMENV(env)[regnum].mem_node`.
sink.note: The saved sanitizer trace reports `heap-use-after-free READ of size 4` at `/src/php-src/oniguruma/src/regcomp.c:715:11` in `node_char_len1`.

tainted_value_origin.description: Persistent alias for the parsed capture node. The compiler records the heap `BAG_MEMORY` node under its capture-group number in `mem_env`, and later backreference handling reloads that pointer from the same table.
tainted_value_origin.value_from: Here `node` is the `BAG_MEMORY` node allocated from the witness-controlled named capture at step 1, and `num` is that capture's assigned group number.
tainted_value_origin.note: Nothing clears this `mem_env` slot when `node_reset_str()` later frees the underlying capture node, so the table entry becomes the stale pointer that reaches the sink.

parser_admitted.code: if ((err_code = onig_new(&retval, (OnigUChar *)pattern, (OnigUChar *)(pattern + patlen), options, enc, syntax, &err_info)) != ONIG_NORMAL) {
parser_admitted.description: The staged pattern passes the mbregex encoding check and is handed to Oniguruma for compilation. The crash happens during this compile step, before `_php_mb_onig_search()` uses the subject string.
parser_admitted.note: The saved crash stack reaches `php_mbregex_compile_pattern` frame 8 and never reaches the match call at `php_mbregex.c:938`, so the witness is admitted as a pattern and fails during compile-time tree tuning.

fine_trace.note: The witness-controlled named capture allocates a heap `BAG_MEMORY` node and assigns it capture number `num`. ASan's allocation stack for the later-freed 72-byte region leads back to this parse path via `node_new_memory()` and `parse_bag()`.

After the capture group is parsed, the compiler stores the same `BAG_MEMORY` node from step 1 in the per-group `mem_env` table. That table entry survives later optimization passes and becomes the stale alias used after free.

Before `tune_tree()` runs, `check_backrefs()` visits a backreference from the same pattern and marks the capture node stored in `mem_env` as `BACKREF`. This is the 'capture group is back-referenced' state that the vulnerable empty-look-behind optimization fails to respect.

During the free-causing `tune_look_behind()` invocation, Oniguruma computes the look-behind body's character-length summary into `ci`. The saved free stack proves that this analysis made the immediately following branch at line 4500 true, i.e. the invocation reached the `ci.min == 0 && ci.min_is_sure != 0` optimization case.

Root cause step. The current source optimizes this sure-zero-length look-behind to empty even though step 3 already established that its capture node is back-referenced. The missing `used == FALSE` guard lets `onig_node_reset_empty(node)` free a capture subtree that is still reachable through `mem_env`.

`onig_node_reset_empty(node)` enters `node_reset_str()` and recursively frees the look-behind body. The saved ASan free stack shows `node_free_body()`/`onig_node_free()` releasing the 72-byte capture node allocated at step 1 during this reset.

Later on the same compile path, a backreference-length computation reloads the capture pointer from `mem_env`. Because step 2's table entry was never cleared after step 6 freed the capture node, this recursive call receives a dangling `Node*`.
Sink. The recursive call from step 7 dereferences the freed `Node` header to read `node_type`, and ASan reports the resulting heap-use-after-free READ 4 at this line.

format.name: raw regex byte string for php-fuzz-mbstring
format.contract: The exact staged 192-byte file is passed unchanged as the regex pattern string to `mb_ereg()`/`mb_eregi()` by `php-fuzz-mbstring`; the compile step crashes before matching uses the subject string. The witness begins `(?<=` and contains named captures `(?<E>.)` together with `\k<E>` backreferences inside look-behind constructs, which is sufficient on the staged vulnerable source to allocate a capture node, leave it aliased in `SCANENV_MEMENV`, and then hit the empty-look-behind optimization that frees a still-back-referenced capture subtree.
